name: Union City Transit: Paratransit
fullDescription: Union City Transit provides ADA paratransit service for Union City residents who cannot use regular bus service due to a disability.
whatTheyOffer:
- Door-to-door shared ride service
- ADA service within Union City city limits
- Paratransit Plus (non-ADA) with limited service to southern Hayward and northern Fremont and Newark
- Reservations up to 3 days in advance
- Same fares as Union City Transit; 10-ride ticket book $27.50
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the ADA Paratransit Application (fill out online, then print, sign, and mail)
2. Request a printed copy by calling 510-675-5373
3. Assessment may be required
4. Once certified, book rides by calling 510-476-1500, option 1 (8 am-5 pm daily)
keywords: Union City, paratransit, ADA, Alameda County, disability, wheelchair, door to door
